shots.caption: Bly. A house that forgets nothing.
shots.visual_gloss: An aerial view of Bly, isolated in a grey, misty landscape. Dark windows appear to watch the viewer. Silent, oppressive atmosphere.

shots.caption: She sees them. Or does she believe she does?
shots.visual_gloss: A close-up of the governess’s hands holding a letter tightly. Her partially visible face expresses quiet unease. Dim light casts soft shadows.
shots.native_text_note: The French visual prompt contains the typo “gouvernasse”; this reading aid uses the intended word “governess”. The native prompt is preserved below.

shots.caption: The children confirm nothing. But they know.
shots.visual_gloss: Miles and Flora sit in an empty drawing room, avoiding the camera. The atmosphere carries a silent tension; old furniture seems to bear the weight of the past.
shots.separate_editorial_proposal: The children confirm nothing. What do they know?

shots.caption: Read it. Decide for yourself.
shots.visual_gloss: The governess stands beside a window, looking outside. Her silhouette is blurred and indistinct. Thickening mist erases the contours of the world beyond.
